fees.notes: Official Curtin Malaysia 2026 international fee: RM5,100 per unit (25 credit points); total depends on units taken, not published as a fixed total. Excludes 6% SST applicable to international students from 1 Jul 2025. Official Curtin Malaysia indicative course fees, 2026 intake (International column); page updated 12 Aug 2026. Source: https://curtin.edu.my/study/fee/course-fees/ (checked 2026-09-18).
